# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented here.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html)

## [Unreleased]

### Features

- Deterministic German-first NLU for Home Assistant Assist
- English language pack alongside German
- Home Assistant conversation integration with optional LLM fallback
- Multi-arch Linux builds (x86_64, aarch64, armv7)
